text: Pakriban keuh gravitasi bumoe lo itarek lôn? Meunyö droeneuh neudöng ateueh lo, geuhöndroeneuh jeuet keu phui nibak Bumoe.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Sidroe ureueng nyang geuhön geuh 200 pon (90kg) i Bumoe keuneuk na geuhön sangkira 36 pon (16kg) bak lo. Lheuhnyan gravitasi, teuntѐejih, kureueng itarek droeneuh.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Mata uroe hana krak lagѐe Bumoe nyang jeuet ta döng. Mandum mata uroe geupeugoet nibak gah, apui, ngön plasma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Gah jeuet leubeh lipéh watѐe droeneuh neupeujioh pusat mata uroe.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Blah luwa nyang takalön watѐe ta pandang mata uroe jikheun fotosfer nyan meumakna "bola hu".
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Sangkira na lhee ribѐe thôn ukeu, bak thôn1610, astronomi Italia Galileo Galilei geungui teleskop keu geutilek bahwasajih Venus na fase, lagѐe buleuen.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Fase nyan jeuet sabab saboh sagai sagoe Venus (atawa buleun) nyang ipeukeu Mata Uroe nyang trang. Fase-fase Venus sapeu kheun keu tiori Copernicus bahwasajih planet-planet iputa Mata uroe.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Teuma, meupadum thôn ukeu bak thôn 1639, sidroe astronomi Inggreh nanjih Jeremiah Horrocks geutilek transit Venus.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Inggréh ka geurasa masa damai nyang cukôp panyang lheuëh penaklukan Danelaw.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Tapi, nibak thôn 991 Ethelred dipeuhadap deungön Armada Viking nyang leubéh rayek daripada armada laén sejak Guthrum mat kuasa siabad sigohlomjih.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Armada nyoë ipimpin lé Olaf Tryggvason, ureuëng Norwegia nyang seumangat that geurebôt lom negarajih dari kekuasaan ureuëng Denmark.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Lheuëh kemunduran militer nyang awai, Ethelred sepakat ngön persyaratan nyang dipeugot Olaf, nyang balék u Norwegia icuba reubôt keulai kerajaanjih deungön hasé nyang biasa.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul nyankeuh salah saboh alfabet nyang geusahja geupeugöt lam geumeubasa siuroe-uroe nyang meusyeuhu. Alfabet itumee bak thôn 1444 bak masa keurajeuen Raja Sejong (1418-1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Raja Sejong nyankeuh raja keupeut nibak Dinasti Joseon ngön nyankeuh salah saboh nyang paléngpaléng jitabék.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Gobnyan phôn that nan geuh alfabet Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, nyang meumakna “su nyang beutôi keu peutunyok ureueng".
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Hinan na padum-padum boh tiori pakriban basa Sansekerta na. Salah sabohjih nyankeuh migrasi Arya nibak blah barat u India nyang imee basa awaknyan.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sansekerta nyankeuh basa jameun nyang seubandeng deungön basa Laten nyang jingui i Eropa.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Buku keu phon that nyang ithei le donya ituleh lam basa Sansekerta. Oh lheueh komplikasi Uphanishad, basa Sansekerta ka li sabab hierarki.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sansekerta nyankeuh basa nyang paléng sampoerna ngön kaya, nyang jeut keu asai keu dum basa India nyang ka maju, sama lagѐe basa Laten nakeuh asai keu basa Eropa lagѐe Peurancih ngön Spanyol.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: DeuDeungön abéhjih prang keu Peurancih, Jeurman ipuphon keu jak reubôt pulo Britania.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Nan sani prang Jeurman “Opeurasi Singa Laot”. Dum beudé geuhön ngön peunajôh Teuntra Inggreh ka gadöh watѐe ipinah nibak Dunkirk, teuma teuntra nyan sep leumöh.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Teutapi Teuntra Laôt Keurajeuen Inggreh mantông leubѐh teuga ibandeng Teuntra Laôt Jeurman (‘Kriegsmarine”) ngön jeuet ipeuancô dum armada prang nyang ikirem jeumeurang Lueng Laôt Inggreh.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Beuranggadum, bacut that kapai-kapai Teuntra Laôt Keurajeuen Inggreh nyang na rap deungön rot-rot nyang mungken ikeupong kareuna lakseumanajih yoe awak nyan ipeukaram le aneuk beude kapai phoe teuntra Jeurman.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Jak ta puphon deungön saboh haba peukara hajat Itali. Itali nyan jameun nyankeuh "adoe" Jeurman ngön Jeupang.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Jih na teuntra darat nyang leubeh leumoh ngön teuntra laôt nyang leubeh leumoh, adakpih awak nyan ban lheueh ipeugoet peuet boh kapai barô sigohlom prangipuphon.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Hajat Itali nyang phon nyankeuh nanggroe-nanggroe Afrika. Keu ireubot nanggroe-nanggroe nyan, awak nyan suwah na saboh teumpat keu ipeutren teuntra, ngön teuntra awak nyan beu jeuet imeulayeue jeumeurang Laôt Meiterania ngön reubot Afrika.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Keu ipubuet nyan, awak nyan suwah ipeuanco eumpung-eumpung teuntra Inggreh ngön kapai-kapai nyang na bak Meuse. laénSeulaén nibak buet nyan, kapai-kapai prang Itali han suwah ipubuet dumpeue.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Jinoe keu Jeupang. Jeupang jameun nyankeuh saboh nanggroe pulo, saban sit lagѐe Inggreh.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Kapai nom nyankeuh kapai nyang ipeugoet keu ijak i yup ie, ngön teutap hinan sampoe watѐe nyang ka ipeuteuntee.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Kapai nom nyan ingui bak Prang Donya I ngön Prang Donya II. Watѐe nyan awak nyan leupah meulet ngön timbakjih iphee leupah rap.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Watѐe phon prang awak nyan paléng kayem ijak i ateueh laôt, teutapi watѐe radar ka ipeugoet leubeh got ngön ka lebeh pah kapai-kapai nom nyan iyue jak u yup ie bah han jeuet ikalon.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Kapai nom ureueng Jeurman nanjih U-Boats. Ureueng Jeurman jroh that bak ime rakan bak ingui kapai nom awak nyan.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Seubab awaknyan jrôh deungön kapai nom, oh lheueh prang nyan Ureueng Jeurman han ipateh keu imat jai kapai nom.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Beutôi! Raja Tutankhamun, meujan-jan ikheun seubagoe "Raja Tut" atawa "Raja Aneuk Agam", nyankeuh sidroe Raja Ureueng Meuse nyang paléng meusyeuhu nibak watѐe jinoe.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Nyang gurajih, gobnyan han ikheun peunténg that bak watѐe jameun dilee ngön han meutuleh bak riwayat-riwayat raja jameun ilee nyang kayem na.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: lagѐe Beuranggadum, jeurat gobnyan nyang iteumee bak thon 1922 peujeuet gobnyan sebagoe ureueng nyan meusyeuhu. Adakpih jai jeurat-jeurat jameun dilee nyang irupah, jeurat nyoe teudong lagѐe soet han ipeukacho.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Dum dabeuh-dabeuh nyang meutanom sajan Tutankhamun ka ikawai deungön got, roh sit meuribee artefak-artefak nyang ipeugoet deungön beusoe ngön batee-batee nyang jareung na.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Peuneujeuet ruda meujaroe peugoet sado Ureueng Asyur leubeh phui, leubeh bagah, ngön leubeh seuiya keu ime teuntra ngön sado laén.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Aneuk panah nibak panah awak nyan nyang paloe nyan jeuet peureuloh bajee beuso teuntra musoh. Kureueng leubeh bak thon 1000 S.M., Ureueng Asyur geupeugoet kavaleri nyang phon.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Kavaleri nyankeuh teuntra nyang meuprang nibak rueng guda. Peulana gohlom itumee, teuma awak kavaleri Asyur nyan meuprang i ateueh rueng soh nibak guda-guda awak nyan.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Geutanyoe jai taturi Ureueng Yunani nyang ahli peulitek, ahli sains, ngön ahli seuni. Mungken ureueng nyang paléng meusyeuhu nibak piyasan nyoe nyankeuh Homer, ureueng buta nyang kheun panton nyang meusyeuhu that, nyang geukarang duwa peuneugot nibak literatur Ureueng Yunani: panton Iliad ngön Odyssey.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles ngön Aristophanes nyan ureueng nyang meu’en dalupa nyang mantong meusyeuhu ngön dalupa awak nyan ithee seubagoe salah saboh nyang paléng got nibak literatur donya.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Ureueng Yunani nyang meusyeuhu nyang laén nyankeuh ahli matematik Pythagoras, kayem ituri nibak teori gobnyan nyang meusyeuhu teuntang hubongan bineh-bineh lhee sagoe singkee.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Na muebagoe sangkira keu padum jai ureueng nyang peugah haba basa Hindi. Nyoe geukira sajan nibak basa keuduwa ngön keupeut nyang paléng umum jingui i donya.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Jumlah peunutoe aseuli meumacam bagoe meunurot nibak pue dialek nyang teukaet brat atawa hana.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Keunira sangkira nibak 340 juta sampoe 500 juta peunutoe, ngön na 800 juta ureueng jeuet meuphom basa nyan.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi ngön Urdu nyan hie lam kusakata tapih meubeda lam skrip; lam peunutoe siuroe-uroe, peunutoe keuduwa basa nyan biyasa jih jeuet sapue pham.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Sangkira abda keu-15, Estonia Utara na keuh imiyup peungaroeh budaya Jeurman nyang rayeuk.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Padum droe biarawan Jeurman meuheut geume Tuhan leubeh toe deungön ureueng gampong aseuli, nyangkeuh awak nyan jipeugöt basa harfiah Etonia.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Nyan meuasai nibak alfabet Jeurman ngön saboh sipheut "Õ/õ" jipeutamah.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Seuireng watѐe ijak, jai kalimah nyang jipinjam nibak basa Jeurman jeuet keu saban. Nyoe keuh awai nibak penceurahan.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Meunurot tradisional, peuwareh tahta laju itamoeng militer oh lheuh peuseuleusoe sikula.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Beuranggadum, Charles ijak u kampus i Trinity College, Cambridge dipat jih meurunoe Antropologi ngön Arkeologi, ngön oh lheuh nyan Seujarah, meutume 2:2 (laqab glah duwa nyang leubeh miyup).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles nakeuh anggota phon nibak Keuluwarga Keurajeuen Inggreh nyang geubi geular.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turki Eropa (Thrace timu atawa Rumelia i seumeunanjong Balkan) meulingkeu 3 % nanggroe.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Wilayah Turki na keuh panyang leubeh nibak 1.600 kilomete (1.000 mil) ngön bideung 800 km (500 mil) luwah, beuntoek sangkira peutsagoe panyang.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Wilayah Turki, itamoeng dano, iduek 783.562 kilometer peutsagoe (300.948 sq mi), na keuh 755.688 kilometer peutsagoe (291.773 sq mi) sapat i Asia barat daya ngön 23.764 kilometer peutsagoe (9.174 sq mi) i Eropa.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Wilayah Turki jeuet keu nanggroe rayeuk keu-37 Idonya, ngön sangkira dumrayeuk Metropolitan Peurancih ngön Inggreh meuseu tapeusapat.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turki ikeulileng le laôt bak lhee sagoe: Laôt Aegea i barat, ngön Laôt Itam i Utara, ngön Laôt Mediterania i selatan.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luksemburg na saboh hikayah panyang teutapi meurdehka jih bak thon 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Ladom Belgia watѐe nyoe nakeuh ladom Luksemburg masa u likot teutapi jeuet keu Belgia oh lheueh Revolusi Belgia thon 1830an.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luksemburg sabe useuha keu teutap jeuet nanggroe netral teutapi di giduek mandua Prang Donya I ngön Prang Donya II le Jeurman.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Bak thon 1957 Luksemburg jeuet anggota peudong organisasi nyang jino meugah seubagoe Uni Eropa.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong nakeuh saboh beunteung nyang anco ngön biara Buddha bak ateueh Distrik Paro (bak gampong Phondey).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Dipeugah bak thon 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel peugoet beunteung keu peuingat juwara lawan sidadu Tibet-Mongol.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Bak thon 1951, apui teutet seubap ladom geutinggai Drukgyal Dzong nyang euntee, lagѐe patong Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Oh lheueh apui teutet, beunteung geulestarikan ngön geupelindong, teutap jeuet salah saboh atraksi paléng sensasional bak Bhutan.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Watѐe abad ke-18 Kamboja meuteume droe meuseupet bak antara, teutangga nyang kreuh, Thailand ngön Vietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Ureueng Thailand invasi Kamboja beberapa kali abda ke-18 ngön bak thon 1772 awak nyan geupeuanco Phnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Bak thon-thon akhe abad keu-18, Vietnam pih menginvasi Kamboja.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Lapan blah peureusen ureueng Venezuela hana keureuja, ngön ladom rayeuk nibak awak nyan keureja bak ekonomi hana formal.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Duwa peurlhee nibak ureueng Venezuela nyang keureuja pubuet bak sektor guna, karap sepeurpeut keureuja bak industri ngön sepeurlimong keureuja bak meugoe.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Saboh industri peunténg bak Venezuela nakeu minyeuk, dipat nanggroe nyan nakeuh ekspor gleh, beu that saboh peureusen keureuja bak industri minyek.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Bak phon nanggroe meurdehka, ahli Lampoh Raya Singapura geutulông ubah pulo nyan jeuet saboh Kuta Taman tropis.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Bak thon 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, hibrida anggrek, geupileh sebagoe bungong nanggroe.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Tiep thon seulingka buleun Oktober karap 1,5 juta herbivora geujak u darat seulatan, jeumeurang Krueng Mara, nibak gle utara keu ujeuen.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Oh lheuh nyan gisa teuma u utara leupah barat, sigoe teuk jeumeurang Krueng Mara, oh lheueh ujeun bak buleun April.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Teumpat Sarengeti meuasoe Taman Nasional Serengeti, Mukim Konservasi Ngorongoro ngön Keuneubah Meuneu'en Maswa i Tanzania ngön Cagar Nasional Maasai Mara i Kenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Meureunoe keu ta peuna media nyang interaktif peureulee keu cara biyasa ngön cara nyang ka meubudaya, nyan peureulee cit keu peukakah hayeu keu glah nyang interaktif (papeun ceurita, audio ngön video edit, peugah ceurita, dsj.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Beuntuk nyang interaktif nyan peureule keu gata taboeh yum lom sigoe teuk prasangka droeneuh keu peuna media ngön neumeurunoe keu neu pikee lam saboh cara nyang hana saban.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Beuntuk interaktif nyan peureule keu meubagoe beukai nibak saboh proyek keu tasambong saboh keu nyang laén, tapi jitamoeng cit lam akai keuneuk saboh hai nyang meucebre.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Nyang kureueng get nibak gaca lensa zoom nyan nakeuh bahwasajih fokus nyang payah ngön numboi nibak beukai gaca lensa nyan peureule keu beutrôh u saboh titek jioh fokus nyang leubeuh rayeuk nibak gaca lensa nyang phon.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Nyoe keuneuk meupeukara nyang leubeh ubeut meunyö ureueng nyang peugoet gaca lensa nyan jeuet geutumee saboh standar nyang leubeh hayeu lam geupeugoet gaca lensa.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Nyoe nyang peumungken gaca lensa zoom keu jipeuhase gamba nyang getjih nyan seubandeng deungön gaca lensa deungön focus jioh nyang teutap.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Nyang kureueng get laén nibak gaca lensa zoom nyoe nakeuh maksimum buka khopjih (bagah) nibak gaca lensa nyang ladôm leumoh.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Nyoe musabab keu gaca lensa zoom nyang murah payah that dingui lam keuadaan kureueng hu meunyö hana cahya meu ble-ble.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Salah saboh masalah nyang paléng umum 'oh watèë cuba ubah film u format DVD nakeuh pemindaian berlebih atawa overscan.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Biasajih tv dipeugot deungön cara keu peusenang masyarakat umum.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Sabab alasan nyan, bandum nyang droëneuh kalön di TV na batah terteuntèë nyang dikoh, ateuh, miyup, ngön sampéng.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Kuwasa nyang timang nakeuh saboh sistem nyang bansa Eropa geuuseuha keu geujaga wilayah bansa nyang bibeuh ban mandum nanggroe di Eropa.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Prang Wareh Bansa Spanyol jitanda nibak prang nyang keuphon deungön peukara nyang utama nyankeuh keu peutimang kuwasa.

text: Nyoe jitanda meuubah nyang peunténg, sabab kuwasa Eropa nyan hana dipeunan le sebagoe prang ateueh nan agama. Nyan, Prang Lhee Ploh Thon nyang jeuet keu prang paléng akhe nyang jeuet jipeunan seubagoe prang ateueh nan agama.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Teumpat keuramat Artemis bak Efesus nyan ka ancoe bak tanggai 21 Juli, thon 356 SM lam saboh buet teumeutet nyang dipeugöt le Herostratus.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Lagѐe nyang meutuleh lam calitra, meukeusut gobnyan nyankeuh bah meuceuhu adak pakribanpih carajih. Ureueng-ureueng Efesus, beungeh that, dibrithee bahwasajih nan Herostratus han tom dituleh.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Ahli seujarah asai Yunani Strabo dudoe geutuleh nanjih, teuma nyankeuh nyang peugöt tanyoe tupeue uroe nyoe. Teumpat keuramat nyan ancoe bak saban malam watѐe Aleksander Agung lahe.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Aleksander, seubagoe raja, geupeutaba bayeue keu peudong lom teumpat keuramat nyan, tapi hajatjih nyan ditulak. Dudoe, oh lheueh Aleksander mate, teumpat keuramat nyan dipeudong lom bak thon 323 SM.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Neupeuteuntee jaroe gata seuguruek mungken watѐe teungoh neutuleh mandum kheuet nyoe deungon beutôi – pih bek neutree peugöt jai buet leubeh laén deungon aneuk jaroe gata.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Mistisisme nyankeuh buet peulet meusapat deungon, meusipheuet deungon, atawa dithee meutupeue nibak sipheuet nyata nyang paléng manyang, sipheuet tuhan, sipheuet aruwah nyang beutôi, atawa Tuhan.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Ureueng-ureueng nyang pateh geumita nyumjih deungon lansong, grak ate, atawa eleumee lam sipheuet nyata tuhan/dewa atawa dewa-dewa.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Ureueng-ureueng nyang ikot nyan geumita cara-cara udep nyang meuteuntee, atawa buet-buet nyang dimeukeusud keu peulara nyum-nyum nyan.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhisme nyankeuh saboh agama nibak daerah benua India. Nyan asaijih bak daerah Punjab watѐe abad keu-15 nibak meupisah sekte lam peurangui Hindu.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Sikh pikee agama awak nyan jeuet keu saboh agama nyang meupisah nibak agama Hindu adakpih awak nyan ditupue nyan ukheue-ukheue nibak Hindu ngön peurangui.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sikh dikheun agama awaknyan Gurmat, nyankeuh Punjabi keu "jalan nibak guree)". Guree nyankeuh saboh hai peunténg nibak mandum agama-agama India tapi Sikhisme ka dicok keu saboh hai nyang peunténg nyang peugöt uram nibak agama Sikh.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Agama nyan ka ipeudoeng bak abad keu 15 le Gure Nanak (1469-1539). Na sikureueng droe gure meuikot-ikot keuneulheuh nyan.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Beuranggandum, bak buleun Juni 1956, janji Krushchev jiujoe watѐe karu i Polandia, dipat ureueng-ureueng keureuja ka geumeudawa han sep peunajoh ngön ikoeh gaji, meu ubahjeuetkeu dawa ureueng ramee bak Komunisme.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

eng_text: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: MRI nyan ateuh dasar saboh fenomena nyata nyang dikheun sabagoe resonansi magnet inti (NMR), nyang geuteume wate thon 1930an le Felix Bloch (nyang geukeureuja bak Universitas Stanford) ngön Edward Purcell (nibak Universitas Harvard).
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Lam resonansi nyoe, bideung magnet ngön geulumbang radio geupeujeuet atom keu i peuteubit sinyal radio nyang haloh.
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Lam watee thon 1970, Raymond Damadian, sidroe dokter medis ngön sidroe eleumewan riset, geuteume asai dari geungui resonansi magnet keu gamba sabagoe saboh dabeuh keu diagnosa medis.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Peuet thon dudoe saboh paten ka geubrie, nyang keu paten nyang keuphôn that na lam bideung MRI.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Lam 1977, Dr. Damadian geupeuleuh peunyang geupeuget akan keuphôn that dari “saboh-badan” dabeu MRI keu scan, nyang jiboh nan le gobnyan sebagoe “Indomitable”.
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Komunikasi nyang hana meusambong peureulee keu watѐe keu takalon droe ngön jawaban dari ureueng.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Nyoe akan dipeujeuet murid keu dikeureuja lam langkah droejih ngön jeuet ta jaga Langkah dari peurintah informasi.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Keutamah, na bacut wate nyang ditheun dengön watѐe keureuja nyang mungkén jeuet ta ubah. (Bremer, 1998)
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Ngui keu internet ngön Jareng Luah Donya nyan jeuet keu sidreo ureueng nyan keugeucok dum informasi lam saban watee.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Murid nyan jeuet cit geujok pertanyaan lam meubagoe watee lam si uroe ngön gueharap jaweub nyan bagah, nibak suwah preh oh watee meureumpok seucara lansong.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Geupeutoe meurenoe cara nyang leubѐh maju geupeutaba keubebasan nibak absolut. Hana saboh cara nyang get keu meureunoe.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Deuh takaloen, hana saboh hai nyang get keu meurenoe. Meurenoe jeuet nibak peungalaman ureueng meurenoe ngön ileume nyang na.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Peungalaman kamoe saat nyoe deungön pubuet-keudroe ngön informasi nyang na, meurenoe-meudasar acara tivi meugamba hai nyoe.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Jai that nibak geutanyoe meureumpok droe geukalon acara tivi nyang ipeuleumah geutanyoe saboh buet atawa peungalaman bak geutanyoe hantom sapeu kheun atawa ngui ileume nyan.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Geutanyoe hantom peugot saboh moto, geupeudong ie mancue bak likot rumoh geutanyoe, saweu u Peru keu pareksa runtohan jameun, atawa peugot teuma rumoh ureueng silingka geutanyoe.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Beurkat link kawat optic imiyup laot u Eropa ngön sateulit broadband, Greenland ka meusambong ngön 93% populasi na geuakses internet.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Hotel atawa ureueng rumoh gata (miseu tinggai bak wisma atawa rumoh droe) mungkén na wifi atawa PC meusambong bak internet, ngön mandum teumpat na warong internet atawa padum boh teumpat deungön wifi ureueng ramee.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Lagee jiseubot di ateueh, bahpih kata "Eskimo" jiteurimong di Amerika Seurikat, kata nyan jianggap meupeureundah ureueng-ureueng nyang kon Amerika. Ureueng Arctic, teukeuphon that ureueng Kanada.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Bahpih mungken gata meudeungo kata nyan jipakek le peundudok aseuli Greenland, nyang jipakek nyan wajeb jise le ureueng aseng.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Peundudok aseuli Greenland jiseubot droejih seubagoe ureueng Inuit di Kanada ngon Kalaalleq (jamak Kalaallit), saboh peundudok Greenland, di Greenland.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Buet broek, ngoen niet broek keu ureueng aseng bak umumjih, seubeutoijih karab hana geuturi bak Greenland. Adakpi i kuta, hideh hana "dairah gasa."
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Cuwaca leupie mungken saboh bahya nyang deuh geuneuk hadapi le ureueng nyang hana ase.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Meunyoe neujak saweu Greenland seulama masa leupie (beuteuingat maken jioh u baroh neujak, maken brat leupie), nyoe peureulee tame bajee nyang sep seuuem bacut.
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Uroe nyang panyang bak musem seuuem jeuet keu seubab peukara hana sep eh ngoen teusangkot peukara keusihatan.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Nibak musem seuuem, beuteugoh that sit keu jamok Nordik. Adakpih jamok nyan hana jipeuek dum penyaket, jamok nyan jeuet keu deuge teuh.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Adakpih ekonomi San Fransisco meusangkot ngön nyan keu galak jamѐe glah-donya, ekonomi jih kaleuh jipareksa mandum.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Sektor teunaga keureja paleng rayeuk nakeuh jasa profesional, pomeurintah, keuangan, meudagang, ngön pariwisata.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Nyan gamba nyang kayém lam lagu, pileuem, sastra ngön budaya meuceuhu ka geubantu peugot kuta ngön landmark diteupue bak sigom donya.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Fransisco ka geukeumbangkan infrastruktur peungunjong nyang rayeuk deungön le hotel, teumpat seumajoh, ngön teumpat keuseupakatan glah-ateuh.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Fransisco nakeuh saboh teumpat paleng get bak nanggroe nyan keu seumajoh Asia laen: Korea, Thailand, India, ngön Jepang.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Meusaweu u Walt Disney World nakeuh ziarah keuphôn keu jai keuluwarga Ameurika.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Saweu "khas" geupeutamoeng poe u Bandara Internasional Orlando, ek moto bes u saboh teumpat hotel Disney, peuhabeh sangkira saboh aleuhad han geutinggai properti Disney, ngön woe u rumoh.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Na meumacam nyang hana meubatah nyang mungkén, tapi nyoe teutap peurlee peue nyang ureueng maksud watѐe awaknyan peugah haba "jak u Disney World".
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Dum tiket nyang jipeubloe online rhot situs lage eBay atawa Craigslist bacut dingui tiket park-hopper le-uroe.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Adakpih nyoe na keuh saboh keugiatan nyang umum, tapih geuteugah le Disney: tiket hanjeuet pinah jaroe.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Tiep-tiep nyang eh di yup Grand Canyon wajeb na idin kunjong u duson.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Idin nyan ijok padum boh sagai sabab neuk peulindong panton cot, ngon jipeulot ureueng peusan bak uroe phon awai buleuen, peuet buleuen sigohlom buleuen nyan puphon.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Makajih, meunyoe neuk cok idin kunjong u duson bak buleun Mei na keuh nibak tanggai 1 Januari.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Lapak nibak teumpat nyang sep meuceuhu, lagee Bright Angel Campground nyang toe ngon Phatom Ranch, lazemjih jipeupenoh le peusan nyan jiteurimong bak tanggai phon ibuka reservasi.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Na padum boh lumboi idin sagai ijok keu ureueng nyang jak langsong nyan pih keu ureueng nyang phon trok, nyang phon geulayani.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Tamoeng u Afrika Tunoeng deungön moto nyankeuh cara nyang hayeu keu takaloen dumpue ceudah lagoina teumpat nyan ngön tajak bak teumpat-teumpat iluwa teumpat tamasya biyasa.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Nyoejeuet jipubuet bak moto biyasa deungön peusiyap beugoet tapih 4x4 jiyue ngön jai teumpatjeuet jipeutubiet deungön bus ruda 4x4 panyang.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Beutingat teuh watѐe taneuk peugoet bahpih Afrika Tunoeng saban hana mandum nanggroe silingka.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Syarat ngön eungkoh yum visa meubagoe jinѐh nibak saboh nanggroe laen ngön jipeungaroh le nanggroe asai droeneuh.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Tiep nanggroe sit na qanun ceudah lagoina peu dabeuh nyang meukarat nyang na lam moto.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Ie Teureujun Victoria nyankeuh bak saboh Zimbawa blah barat, leupah ceu nibak Livingstone, Zambia, ngön toe Bostwana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Kuta nyoe nakeuh pah blah deh ie teureujun, ngön phôn that awak nyan galak, tapih niet jak meutamasya nyang meuceuhu nyoe jipeutaba keuduwa keu sibeurangkasoe jak lam uteun ngön ureueng jak tamasya jai watѐe keu tinggai trep hinan.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Bak musem ujeuen (bak buleun November sampoe buleuen Maret), ie jiek sep manyang ngön rhoet nyang hana koen-koen.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Ijamien bulut teuh meunyoe ta jeumeurang tutue atawa tajak ubena rauh nyang meuluwek-luwek bak ie teureujun.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Blah laen, nyankeuh musabab iejih sep manyang sampoe deuh takaloen ie teureujun nyang seubeutoijih jipadoek le mandum ie!
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Kubu Tutankhamum (KV62). KV62 mungkén nyang paleng meusyeuhu nibak kubu i Panton, teumpat geutumee Howard Carter thon 1922 bak bhom pang ulee meuligoe nyang karap punoh.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Tabandeng ngön ladom jrat pang ulee nyang laen, adakpih, jrat Tutankhamun karap hana patot ta saweu, jeuet keu ubeut ngön hiyasan ube pah.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Sibeurangkasoe nyang meuheut kaloen bukti reulhoeh patong nyang jipeugoet nibak ta ilah daya keu jipeutubiet bak keureunda sabab teulah geuh sit ulee ngön baho sagai nyang deuh.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Meugah jrat nyang hayeu nyan hana le hinan, tapih ka jipinah u misium Mesir i Kairo.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Jamѐe troek siat leubѐh get geupeu abeh watѐe awaknyan i teumpat laen.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km blah tunoeng barat dari Siem Reap. Candi bak pucak buket nyoe dipeudong bak akhé abad keu-9, watѐe masa Raja Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Keuadaan nyang reumang-reumang bak candi ngön pue nyang deuh i ateuh Dano Tonle Sap dipeugot buet ek u buket nyan na paidah.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Neukunjong u teumpat nyan jeuet deungon teuseuheh digabong deungön saboh kunjongan deungon jalo u dano nyan.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Karcih Angkor nyan peureulee keu neutamong lam candi makajih bek tuwoe neumee paspor sajan droeneuh watѐe neujak u Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Yerusalem nyankeuh ibukuta ngön kuta nyang paleng rayeuk bak Israel, bah pih dum nanggroe laen ngön Seurekat Nanggroe-Nanggroe han dipeunyata nyan seubagoe ibukuta Israel.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Kuta jameun dilee bak Buket Judean nyan na saboh seujarah nyang lagak nyang trepjih meuribee thon.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Kuta nyan keuramat keu lhee agama nyang monoteis - Yahudi, Kristen ngön Islam, ngön jeuet sebagoe pusat rohaniah, agama, ngon budaya.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Seubap meumakna agama nibak Kuta nyan, ngön khususjih jai teumpat nibak dairah Kuta Jameun, Yerusalem nyankeuh saboh nibak teumpat kunjong turis nyang phôn di Israel.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Yerusalem na jai teumpat meuseujarah, arkeologis ngön meubudaya, deungon teumpat meubloe nyang meugah ngön meusak-sak, keude-keude kupi, ngön teumpat-teumpat seumajoh.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ekuador geulake ureueng Kuba teurimong saboh surat undangan sigohlom geutamong Ekuador rot bandara internasional atawa teumpat tamong nyang paleng luwa.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Surat nyoe suwah dipeusaheh le Meuntroe Luwa Nanggroe Ekuador, ngön pateh deungön syarat-syarat nyang ka meuteuntee.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Syarat-syarat nyoe jipeugot keu diseudiya saboh buet pinah nyang meususon ile antara manduwa nanggroe nyan.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Ureueng Kuba nyang meumat karcih ijo US suwah jak saweu saboh kanto Konsulat Ekuador keu geutumee saboh peungecualian keu syarat nyoe.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Paspor ata beu sah paleng kuereung 6 buleuen ‘oh lheueh tanggai neujak. Tiket jak ngoen woe/sigo jak nyan peureulee meujan padum trep neutinggai.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Jak-jak leubeh murah keu keulompok nyang leubeh rayeuk, artijih meunyo gata sidroe atawa deungon sidroe ngôn sagai, neucuba meurumpok ureueng laen lheueh nyan neupeugot saboh keulompok nyang ureuengjih peuet sampoe nam droe keu tamah sidroe-sidroe ureueng nyang leubeh got.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Bah pih meunan, nyo bek jeuet beutoi-beutoi han neuhiro, seubap kayemjih turis rame that dipeuwet-wet hinan keu dipasoe lam moto.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Nyan deuh seubeutoijih leubeh keu cara peungeut ureueng bah geupateh awaknyan peureulee bayeu leubeh le.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Manyang di ateueh blah baroh ujong dari Machu Picchu nyankeuh gunong meureuleueng, kayem jeuet keu layeu keu cok gamba dari jai gamba nyang tinggai dari teumpat nyan.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Nyan deuh hangeub bacut dari yup, pih nyan meureuleueng ngoen payah bak ta ek, tapi ureueng nyang sep sihat biasajih jeuet geu grak lam watë 45 minet.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Reunyeun batee meuleueng dum bak rot, ngoen di teumpat nyang leubeh reuleueng na taloe beusoe diseudiya keu tumpang mat jaroe.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Nyan dipeugah, beuleuheun habeh naph’ah, ngôn beuleuheun lam teumpat nyang leubeh reuleueng, utamajih watë bulut, nyan bagah jeuet keu bahaya.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Na guha ubit toe deungon pucak nyang peureulee neuliwat, nyan agak miyup ngoen agak arat meusak-sak.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Meukalon situs ngoen meunatang alam i Galapagos nyan paleng mangat deungon peuraho, lagee Charles Darwin peubuet bak thon 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Leubeh dari 60 kapai pesiar meulayeue bak ie Galapagos - nyang rayekjih lot dari 8 sampoe 100 droe peunumpang.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Dum ureueng mangat geupeusan teumpatjih di awai (seubap peuraho biasajih peunoh watë musem rame).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Beu yakin agen nyang neupeusan tiket nyan ureueng nyang mah’e teuntang Galapagos deungon nyang got geutu’oh le macam kapai.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Nyo keu peuyakin peue nyang neuharok ngoen/atawa peue nyang han neuharok nyan pah deungon kapai nyang paleng pah keu awak nyan.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Sigohlom ureueng Spanyol troh bak abad keu-16, bahagian baroh Chili nyan di yup aturan Inca seumentara ureueng asai Araukanians (Mapuche) ditinggai bak tingoeh ngoen tunong Chili.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche pih salah saboh dari keulompok ureueng asai Amerika nyang dudoe nyang meudehka, nyang han punoh dicok keu aturan peugah haba basa Spanyol sampoe ‘oh lheueh Chili meurdehka.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Adakpih Chili dipeunyata meurdehka bak thon 1810 (di teungoh prang Napoleonik nyang peugot Spanyol hana saboh pusat pomeurintah nyang meufungsi lam padum thon), keumeunangan nyang peuteuntee deungon ureueng Spanyol nyan han diteumee sampe thon 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Republik Dominika (Spanyol: Replubica Dominicana) nakeuh saboh nanggroe Karibia nyang tinggai i pulo bagian timu Hispaniola, nyang i bagi ngon Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Seulaen pantee anoe puteh ngoen peumandangan gunong, nanggroe nyoe keuh kuta tuha Eropa nyang na i Amerika, jinoe nyan bagoe Santo Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Pulo nyan phon i tinggai le awak Tainos ngon Karibia. Karibia nyan keuh awak nyang meututo basa Arawakan nibak 10.000 SM.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Lam padum thon nyang singkat alheueh trok awak peunjeulajah Eropa , populasi awak Tainos ka le meukureueng kareuna peunaklok Spanyol.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Meunurot Fray Bartolome de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) antara thon 1492 ngon thon 1498 peunaklok Spanyol ipoh 100.000 droe awak Tainos.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Teumpat nyoe dipeudong seubagoe atrium keu saboh keuseupakatan abad keu-17, nyang Templo de San Diego nyankeuh sagai teumpat nyang seulamat.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Nyan jinoe dipeujeuet keu central plaza, ngoen sabe le macam piasan dipeugot hinan, uroe ngoen malam.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Na padum boh teumpat pajoh bak taman, bak suepot ngon malam hinan na konser pre kayem ibri le gazebo pusat.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (juroeng meucom-com). Duwa boh trah manyang jipeucre le trah manyang 69 sintimete sagai nyankeuh rumoh lagenda cinta jameun.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Keu padum-padum sen na meu padum droe aneuk miet neuk ceurita bak droeneuh.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Pulo Bowen nyan keuh saboh peurjalanan nyang meuceuhu si uroe-uroe atawa abeh peukan geupeutaba ek jaloe, ek gunoeng, keude-keude, teumpat pajoh bu ngoen jai lom.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Keulompok aseuli nyoe na i Howe Sound hana jioh bak Vancouver, ngoen mangat jiakses rot teksi ie nyang dijak bak pulo Granville i pusat kuta Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Keu awaknyan nyang peurasat buet uroe-uroe iluwa rumoh, peurjalanan u jurong laot u langet sep brat peunteng.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1,5 jeum ek moto bak Vancouver) nyan meuhai tapih meuceuhu kareuna bak 2010 Olimpiade Musem leupie.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Bak musem leupie, neupeurasat padum boh ski nyang get i Ameurika Utara, ngon musem seuuem aci cuba padum aseuli dairah gunong nyang get jak ngon geuritan angen gunong.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Idin suwah tapeusan leubeh awai. Droeneuh suwah meurumpok idin keu neu dom i Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena nyan keuh saboh-saboh nyang keumiet tasiyon nyang jipeutaba bilek ngoen peunajoh seuuem seulaen meudom. La Leona, San Pedrillo, ngoen Los Patos jipeutaba meukemah sagai hana jiseudiya peunajoh.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Nyoe geupeueumungken keu aman idin langsong bak taman bak Ureueng Keumiet Tasiyon i Puerto Jiménez, tapi awaknyan hana jitueng kartu keuridit
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Peulayanan taman (MINAE) hana jipeutubiet idin leubeh i sibuleun troek nyang jihindar.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol jipeutaba jipeulaku reservasi ngoen yum US$30, Atawa $10 keu tiket si uroe; meuutit bak trah Corcovado.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Pulo Cook nyankeuh pulo nyang meusapat bebah ngoen Selandia Baro, na i Polysinia, bak teungoh-teungoh blah Tunong Samudra Pasifik.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Nyoekeuh nanggroe keupulowan deungoeun 15 pulo nyang paleng rayek nyang meusipreuk i laot luwahjih 2,2 juta km2.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Deungoen zona watë nyang saban lage Hawai, meujan-jan pulo –pulonyan jikira seubagoe "Hawaii jimiyup".
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Bahpih leubeh ubeut, nyoe teuingat padumdroe jamee tuha Hawaii seugolom jeuet keu keuneugaraan hana mandum teumpat dom ureung luwa nyang luwah ngoen geudong selaenjih.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Pulo Cook hana kuta tapih na meu 15 pulo nyang meubeda. Nyang phôn that nyankeuh Rarotonga ngoen Aitatuki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Bak nanggroe maju uroe nyoe, geupeusedia teumpat eh ngon bu beungoh ka geuangkat jeuet keu bentuk seni.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Dibak ujong ateuh, B&B jeulah meusaeng keu phôn that bak dua hai: teumpat eh ngoen bu beungoh.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Biasajih, bak teumpat nyang paleng get lagee nyan ureueng biasajih meurumpok teumpat eh paling get, mungken ija limbot dipeugot ngon jaroe atawa teumpat eh antik.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Bu beungoh jeuet roeh keumangat musem dairah atawa geuhidang khas poe rumoh.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Teumeuatoe mungken saboh geudong tuha meuseujarah deungon peurabot antik, halaman meurawat ngoen saboh kulam meulangue.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Tamong lam moto gata ngoen pubuet peurjalanan jioh na daya tarek intrinsik lam keusederhana.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Hana lage moto nyang leubeh rayeuk, gata mungken kayem deungoen ba moto gata ngoen geuteupeu batahjih.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Peudong saboh tenda bak properti ata droe atawa bak saboh kuta deungoen ukuran padumpih jeuet deungoen mudah geutarek peurhatian.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Paneukjih, neupakek moto gata nakeuh cara paleng get keu peurjalanan tapi jareung jeuet keudroe cara keu "kemah".
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Meukemah moto jeuet mungken miseu gata na minivan rayeuk, SUV, Sedan atawa Station Wagon deungoen kurusi nyang jeuet dipeueh.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Padum boh hotel geupeuwareh nibak jameun meuh geurita apui uap ngoen kapai laot; seugohlom Prang Dônya keudua, bak abad keu-19 atawa toe keu-20.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Hotel-hotel nyoe teumpat ureueng kaya ngoen ureueng meuceuhu oh uroe geupiyoh, ngoen kayem geupeurasat pajoh bu malam ngoen suasana malam sep meuseunang.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Peukakah jameun dum, hana fasilitah nyang baro, ngoen umue nyang get nyan kajeuet keu siphuet awak nyan.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Seumentarajih awak nyan kayem ime atra droe ih, meujan-jan awak nyan geu idang keu Presiden atawa Peujabat laen nyang troeh.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Sidroe ureueng tamasya nyang jai peng mungken ipike sit ineuk pho ban sigom dônya, han item piyoh bak hotel nyang lage nyan.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Hospitality exchange network nyan keuh saboh organisasi nyang sinambong antara ureueng dengoen ureueng gampong bak teumpat nyan u kuta nyang galak awak nyan saweu.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Meugabong bak jaringan nyan kayem jih sep ngon pasoe formulir online sagai, adakpih padum boh jaringan nyan na jipeutaba atawa jilake tamah syarat.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Dafta teumpat kunjong nyan keuh jeuet keu bukti jiprint atawa online, meujan-jan ngoen referensi dengoen review le awak ureueng jak tamasya nyang laen.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing jiteume bak buleuen Januari 2004 lheueh peupogram komputer Casey Fenton iteume peuneupho murah u Iceland tapi hana tempat piyoh.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Jih jikirem email u mahasiswa bak kampus dairah nyan ngoen jiteurimoeng jai peutaba layanan pree.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Hotel jai ilayani awak muda – tipe umu awak duwa ploh thon – tapih droeneuh kayem that meutume awak ureueng jak tamasya nyang leubeh tuha hinan.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Keuluwarga dengoen anuek miet jareung na, tapi padum boh bilek na nyang ibri ijin awak nyan bak kama pribadi.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Kuta Beijing i Cina neuk jeuet keu kuta poe rumoh Olympic Winter Games bak 2022, nyan neuk juet keu kuta keu phôn poe rumoh nyang na dua boh musem olimpiade seuuem dengoen lupie.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing neuk jeuet keu poe rumoh keu acara phôn ngon seuneulheuh ngon acara eh lam kama.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Acara ski laen na bak teumpat ski Taizicheng i Zhangjiakou, na seukitar 220 km (140 mil) nibak Beijing.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Jai geureja nyang na peurayaan thon nyang geumulai nibak akhee November sampoe seuteungoh Mei, nyan meumacam bagoe meunurot keulender thon tiep-tiep geureja.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Jai festival geureja nyang geurayakan seubagoe bahgian dari thon lahe jih atawa thon lahe peutuha atawa na keujadiyan rayeuk pue laen nyang na meusangkot pawot dengoen geureja nyan.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Festival Geureja Kerala nyang keuh sep galak ta kalon, deungon na prosesi jipungui gajah, orkestra geureja atawa khanduri laen.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: World’s Fair (umumjih jikheun Pameran Dônya, atawa Expo) nyang keuh festival rayeuk internasional bahgian seni deungoen sains.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Nanggroe-nanggroe nyang ikot geu peulemah seuni deungoen pendidikan nyang geupamer bak pavilion nasional keu neuk peudeuh haba-haba dônya atawa budaya ngoen seujarah nanggroe awak nyan.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Expo Hortikultura Internasional nyan keuh khusus acara nyang jipeudeuh meukuntom bungoeng, keubon botani ngoen pue-pue laen nyang na sangkot pawot deungoen seulaman.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Bahpih meunurot tiori acara lage nyan jipeugot tiep-tiep thon (watë awak nyan na bak nanggroe-nanggroe), lam jipubuet tan.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Acara nyoe biasajih sabe na nibak lhee ngoen nam buleuen, ngoen jipeugot bak lapak nyang hana ubiet nibak 50 hektar.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Nyan jai format filem nyang meubeda-beda nyang jipakek ka meuthon-thon. Pileuem standar 35 mm (36 x 24 mm negatif) nyan keuh nibak umumjih.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Jih nyan jeuet neupasoe dengoen mudah habeh, ngoen meutume resolusi nyang kira-kira jeuet ta peubanding deungoen DSLR.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Padum boh kamera deungoen format teungoh jipakek format 6 x 6 cm, leubeh teupat jih 56 x 56 mm negatif.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Nyoe jeuet jibri resolusi karap peuet kali lipat nyang 35 mm negatif (3136 mm2 versus 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Alam luwa nyan salah saboh hai nyang jeuet keu seubap nyang meupakat keu sidroe ahli foto, ngoen peureulee keu tuwah, saba, peungalaman dan dabeuh nyang get.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Sidroe ahli foto alam luwa nyan seureng that han di boh yum le ureueng, tapi lagee ban bidang cok foto lagee lazem jih, saboh foto nyang beutoi jih saban na yum lagee seuribee kata.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Bidang cok foto alam luwa nyan kayem peureulee keu lensa telefoto nyang panyang, adakpi hai lagee saboh kawan cicem atawa makhluk nyang haloh nyang peureulee keu lensa nyang laen.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Le meunatang nyang lagak nyan payah bak tateumee, ngoen lam taman kadang na keuh aturan nyang geularang keu tacok foto keu arah tujuan komersial.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Meunatang juwah kadang jeuet keu malee atawa jeuet keu juwah. Cuawaca kadang jeuet keu leupie, seuuem, atawa seubalekjih meubahaya.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Dônya nyoe na leubeh dari 5.000 basa nyang meubeda-beda, na roeh cit leubeh dari duwa ploh ngôn 50 juta atawa leubeh ureueng nyang geungui basa-basa nyan.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Kata-kata nyang meutuleh nyan kayem leubeh mudah bak ta muphom dibandeng kata nyang di kheun ngôn babah, cit. Nyoe leubeh beutoi lom meunyo keu mita alamat, nyang biasajih hek bak ta kheun deungoen jeulah.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Le dum ban saboh nanggroe nyan beutoi-beutoi jeuet basa Inggreh, ngoen leubeh lom bak nyan gata jeuet neuteumee eleumee nyang jareung na - utamajih bak ureueng nyang leubeh muda.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Neupike, meunyo gata jeuet, sidroe Mancunia, Bostonia, Jamaica ngoen Sidneysider geuduek bak saboh meja geupajoh bu malam bak saboh teumpat seumajoh di Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Ureueng nyan geukhem-khem sabee keudroe-droe geuh ngoen calitra dari tiep-tiep dairah asai ureueng nyan, nyang dipeutroh deungon aksen nyang meubeda-beda ngoen dialek dari teumpat asai maseng-maseng.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Meubloe peunajoh bak supermarket biasajih jeuet keu cara nyang paleng murah keu peutumbon badan. Hana watë keu maguen, pilehan biasajih teubatah keu peunajoh nyang jeuet dipajoh sigra.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Meutamah le supermarket nyang na macam bagoe nyang peuseudiya peunajoh nyang jeuet dipajoh sigra. Ladom na nyang peuseudiya microwave oven atawa alat laen keu peuseuuem peunajoh.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Lam ladom nanggroe atawa macam keude na keuh paleng kureueng saboh teumpat seumajoh di dalam, kayem nyang hana that resmi ngoen yum nyang murah.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Neupeugot ngoen neumee meupadum on policy droeneuh nyang ka meucitak ngoen numboi asuransi droeneuh nyang leungkap sajan droeneuh.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Awak nyan suah geupeukaloen alamat e-mail asuransi ngoen lumboi talipun internasional keu nasihat/otorisasi ngoen peugot tuntutan.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Beuna laen saboh nyang ka meucitak lam tah droeneuh ngoen online (neu e-mail u droeneuh keudroe deungon lampiran, atawa neukeubah lam "cloud").
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Meunyo neujak-jak ngoen laptop atawa tablet, peuduek saboh citak lam memori atawa disc (nyang jeuet diakses adakpi hana internet).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Pih neubri numboi asuransi nyang ka meucitak keu ureueng nyang peungon watë jak-jak ngoen syedara atawa ngôn-ngôn nyang na di rumoh nyang jeuet bantu gata.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Rusa rayeuk (pih dituri deungon nan elk) nyan hakjih han meubahaya, tapi keuneuk dipeulindong droe ih meunyoe awak nyan jiancam.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Yoh ureueng han geukalon rusa rayeuk nyan deueh meubahya, awak nyan meujan geujak rap-rap ngoen geupeugot droegeuh lam bahya.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Peucandu jep alkohol ie jep ube sep. Alkohol jipeungaroh ureueng meumacam bagoe, ngoen neutupeue gareh gata nyan sep peunteng.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Hai keusihatan jangka panyang nyang mungken neurasa jai that jep ie nyan nyankeuh reuloh ate ngoen buta ngoen mate. Bahya nyang mungken nyan meutamah jai meunyoe neujep ie alkohol nyang dipeugot hana idin.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Jiwa hana jeulah meuasoe meubagoe macam hai kuto nyang meubahya lagee metanol, nyang jeuet keu seubap buta atawa mate adakpih lam dosis ubeut.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Gaca mata jeuet leubeh murah bak nanggroe aseng, utamajih bak nanggroe ubeut-wase nyang oengkoh ureueng keureujajih leubeh ubeuet eungkoh.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Neupikee keu neuikot ujoe mata i rumoh, phôn that jih meunyoe dibayeu le asuransi, ngoen neumee resepjih keu neujok bak teumpat laen.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.
