text: Bingkai nan merek nyang meuceuhu teuseudiya bak teumpat nyan biasajih na duwa peukara; ladom dabeuh nyan hana aseuli, ngoen dabeuh nyang jitamoeng nyang aseuli biasajih leubeh meuh’ai dibandeng bak teumpat asai.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kupi nyang keuh salah saboh nyang paleng jai i publoe lam dônya nyoe, ngoen gata mungken keuneuk jai neu teumee meubagoe macam atra nyan i nanggroe droeneuh.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Adakpih meunan, jai that meubagoe cara keu ta jep ie kupi nibak dônya nyoe nyang mungken peureulee tacirasa.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Jak lam reuleueng (atawa: canyoneering) na keuh jak di meuyup saboh reuleueng, nyang mungken kadang thoe atawa punoh ngoen ie.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Jak lam reuleueng peureulee keu tapeusapat padum boh hai dari meulangue, ek cot ngoen grop--tapi meujan peuereulee keu bacut meurunoe atawa ta peugoet badan nyang get nak jeuet ta mubuet (tabandeng ngôn ek bate, nom ngoen scuba atawa ski troen cot, keu tamsee).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Jak jioh nyan nakeuh buet nyang na roh jak ngoen tapak lam alam luwa, biasajih tajak ateuh rauh nyang ka na.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Jak ngoen aki cot uroe na roeh jarak kureueng nibak saboh mil sampoe jarak leubeh jioh nyang jeuet dijak lam siuroe.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Bak siuroe ek gunong sajan jak beumudah peurle bacut persiapan, ngoen tip ureueng nyang sihat jeuet geunikmati nyan.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Keuluarga deungoen aneuk miet peurle leubeh le persiapan, tapi siuroe diluwa rumoh mungken leubeh mangat deungoen aneuk miet ngoen aneuk gohlom sikula.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Secara internasional, na karap 200 organisasi wisata jijak. Le nibak awak nyan dipeudong keudroe.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Peuwareh Global Running Tour, Go running Tour peuhubong lusinan peuna peumandanagan bak peut benua.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Meudasar bak Barcelona Running Tour ngoen Copenhagen Running Copenhagen, nyan bagah that meugabong deungoen Running Tour Prague nyang asaijih di Prague ngoen laenjih.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Na lee hai nyang peurle peutimang sigohlom ngoen watë gata jak bak saboh teumpat.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Watë gata neuk jak, neuharap seumike hana lage awak nyan "woe u rumoh". Adab, undang-undang, peunajoh, lalu lintah, seumedom, standar, basa ngoen laenjih neuk sampoe batas meuteunte nibak dipat gata tinggai.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Nyoe nakeuh saboh nyang peurlee sabe gata ingat, keu kheun keugob nibak meuseuroi atawa mungken hana galak cara lokal keu pubuet.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Agen peurjalanan kana watë abad keu-19. Saboh agen peurjalanan biasajih saboh pilehan nyang get keu peurjalanan nyang leubeh nibak wisata alam sigohlom jih, budaya, basa atawa nanggroe penghasilan dimiyup.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Adakpih le agensi akan geucok leubeh sereng peusanan teurato, le agen khusus bak peurjalanan, kisaran peng atawa tujuan.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Nyan jeuet leubeh get ta ngui agen nyang kayem peusan peurjalanan saban ngoen gata.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Kalon bak peu nyang geupeutaba le agen, peu nyang na bak website atawa bak tingkap toko.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Miseu gata keuneuk kalon dônya deungoen murah, keu peurlee, gaya udep atawa tantangan, padum boh cara keu pubuet nyan.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Bak dasarjih, awak nyan rhot lam dua keulompok: keureuja sira meujak-jak atawa geucoba ngoen peutheun peng teubit gata. Artikel nyoe nakeuh fokus bak nyang akhe.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Keu awak nyan jiseudiya geukorbankan keunyamanan, watë ngoen prediktabilitas keu peutheuen peng teubit sampoe karap nol, kaloen paleng bacut peng keu jak-jak.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Saran nyan asumsijih ureueng meujak-jak hana geuceumeucu, peulanggaran, na partisipasi lam peukan illegal, ureueng lake-lake, atawa eksploitasi ureueng laen keu untong droe.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Saboh poh peupareksa biasajih piyoh keu phôn wate i tron nibak kapai, kapai ie, atawa kendaraan laen.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Nibak keureta apui lewat-batah inspeksi ka jipuebuet wate keureta apui I jak ngoen gata haroh na kartu identitas deungon gata wate neu ek salah saboh keureta apui nyan.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Bak keureta eh malam, paspor jeuet jipeusapat le konduktor seuhingga eh gata hana jipeukaru.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Pendaftaran nakeuh saboh syarat tamah keu proses visa, bak padum boh nanggroe, gata haroh meudaftar dipat ngoen alamat gata tinggai keu pihak berwenang disideh.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Nyoe mungken peurlee geupasoe saboh formulir deungon pulisi di sinan atawa meukunjong u kanto imigrasi.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Bak le nanggroe deungoen hukom lagee nyan, hotel lokal neuk geupubuet pendaftaran (pastikan keu meutanyong).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Lam masalah laen, hanya awak nyan tinggai diluwa akomodasi wisata peurlee mendaftar. Adakpih, nyoe dipeugot hukom jioh leubeh kabo, jadi geumita sigohlom nyan.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Arsitektur na hubongan deungon desain ngon kontruksi geudong. Arsitektur nibak saboh teumpat kayem jeuet daya tarek sidroe turis.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Le geudong nyang cukop ceudah keu jikalon ngoen jipandang nibak bangunan manyang atawa nibak jendela posisi-pah jeuet ceudah keu dikaloen.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Arsitektur meutumpok jioh ngoen bideung laen geutamong lam rencana kuta, teknik sipil, seuni dekoratif, desain bak lam ngoen desain landscape.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Geujok kiban ato le pueblo nyan, gata keuneuk mita jumlah beujelas dônya malam koen jak-jak bak Albuquerque atawa Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Tapi, karap mandum kasino nyang tercantum bak ateueh geujok ie, ngon padum nibak nyan geuba hiburan nyang meumerek (khusohjih nyang rayeuek lam lingka Albuquerque ngoen Santa Fe).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Peuleuheun: bar kuta-ubeut disino hana sabe teumpat get keu peungunjong luwa nanggroe keu duek sajan.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Keu saboh hai, Meksiko Utara Baro kana masaalah khusus deungon ba moto teungoh mabok, ngoen konsentrasi ureueng ba moto mabok manyang toe keu bar kuta-ubeut.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Meugamba atawa ceu –ceu nyang hana meuheut nakeuh jituri seubagoe graffiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Adakpih nyan jioh nibak hai nyang deuh moderen, jai ureueng mungken peuhubong nyan dengoen aneuk muda nyang peureulhoh areuta umum ngoen pribadie geupakek cet geudong.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Tapi, jinoe ka na seuniman buet jaroe nyang caroeng, acara buet jaroe ngon binteh nyang "jeuet le hukom". Gamba buet jaroe lam bagoe nyoe kayem hi karya seuni nibak seuni hana teubaca.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Rhom Bumerang nyan keuh saboh keuahlian nyang meuceuhu nyang galak le ureueng jamee.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Meunyoe droeneuh neuk meurunoe rhom bumerang jiwoe lom bak jaroe droeneuh, neupeuteunte droeneuh meurumpok bumerang nyang pah keu neupuwoe.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Jai bumerang jiseudiya i Australia seubeutoijih hana diwoe. Nyoe that get keu ureueng phôn keu bek geuujoe rhom lam watë meuangen
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Peunajoh Hangi nyan nyang jitaguen lam ruhueng tanoh seuuem.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Ruhueng jipeuseuuem deungoen batee seuuem ngoen apui, atawa bak padum boh teumpat bumoe nyang seuuem geupeugot keu teumpat tanoh jeuet seuuem keudroe.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangi kayem geuboh keu geutaguen lam tradisi panggang keu peunajoh malam.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Na padum – padum boh teumpat jipeutaba seuuem bumoe hangi, adak hangi laenjih jeuet tarasa i Christchurch, Wellington, ngoen bak teumpat laen.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail na duwa boh tingkat i komuter geureutan apui i dalamjih ngoen seukeulileng Cape Town: MetroPlus (geuseubot sit Tingkat Phôn) ngoen Metro (geuseubot Tingkat lhee).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus nyankeuh nyang leubeh mangat ngoen hana that meusak-sak tapih leubeh meuhai bacut, bahpih mantoeng na yang brat murah nibak tiket metro biyasa u Eropa.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Tip geureutan apui na peulatih MetroPlus ngoen Metro; peulatih MetroPlus sabe geuduek bak ujong geureutan apui toe ngoen Cape Town.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Meume keu ureueng laen, meubek tapeulheuh tah nibak deuh bak droe teuh, nyang keu phôn that munyoe droeneuh neuk lingkeu u ceu internasional.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Droeneuh jeuet neuthei droeneuh jiboh seubagoe ureueng nyang mee narkoba hana meuneutupue le droeneuh, nyang neuk peugoet droeneuh meupeukara.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Nyoe teumasok bak preh meubanja, lage asee peulacak narkoba jeuet jiapakek dumjan hana jipeugah-peugah.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Padum boh nanggroe ka ulak hukoman nyang keujam bahpih keu nyang keu phôn meulanggeh; nyoe ka banmandum hukoman keurengkeng leubeh nibak 10 thon atawa matee.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Tah nyang hana soe kalon nyan nakeuh target pancuri ngon keu galak jipeurati le sibeurangkasoe nyang na keurajeun keu jiancam bhom.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: I rumoh, kareuna keunongsabee kumeun bak teumpat droe, hayeujih sep brat manyang gata ka keubai keu kumeun nyan.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Tapih nibak blah dônya nyang laen, dipat euleumee keu fauna bakteri nyang hai baro keudroeneuh, gata mungken leubeh jih neuplueng bak peukara.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Meunan sit, bak cuwaca seuuem bacut, kumeun jitimoh sep bagah ngoen udepjih that trep iluwa tuboh.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Nyangkeuh hantu Pruet Delhi, Kutok Fira’un, Balah deundam Montezuma, ngoen le ngoen awaknyan.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Lage hai jih peukara peulheueh naph’ah bak cuwaca nyang that leupie, peukara lam pruet bak cuwaca seuuem sep umum ngoen jai keujadian jioh that dari karu keu gata tapi hana that meubahaya.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Meunyoe taneuk jak u nanggroe nyang maju keuphon that atawa i bahagian dônya nyang baro-beu bek ta peu eleh akan na mungken teukeujot tanyoe ngôn budaya lua.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Jai jamee nyang timang, ngön caröng ka taloe ngön peurjalanan dônya nyang teungoeh maju, dipat jai peusaban sare budaya ubeut jeuet meutamah bagah.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Nyang phôn bak siuroe-uroe phôn gata, neupike-pike keu neusewa hotel, peunajoh, jiseudiya meugaya lage awak barat ngoen-nyang get keu meutulong peusaban droe.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Bek teungeut bak kasoe atawa diateuh tanoh bak teumpat nyang hana neutupue na meunatang bak daerah gata.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Meunyoe gata nau jak meukemah, neume teumpat eh nyang jeuet taba-ba atawa ayon dodi keu tahindar droe teuh nibak uleue, kala ngoen seujeunehjih.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Pasoe rumoh gata ngoen kupi nyang meuhai ngoen te chamomile nyang peuteunang droe oh watë malam.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Watë gata teungoeh jak liburan bak hotel, gata na watë keu peumangat droe teuh ngoen peuruweung beubrat meu padum minet keu tapeugot saboh nyang istimewa.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Meunyoe gata leubeh galak neujak-jak lam uteun, neucok watë keu neupeugot jus atawa neupeugot meupadit boh smoothie:
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Mungken gata tatumee jep ie nyang biasa nyang jeuet keu bu beungoh watë neuwoe bak keureuja siuroe-uroe.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Meunyoe neutinggai i kuta ngoen meumacam bagoe ie jep bek kayem that neujak bak bar ngoen pub bak nanggroe jiran.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Keu ureueng nyang hana meuphom ngoen jargon medis, kata-kata infeksi atawa meujangket na arti nyang meubeda.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Peunyaket nyang jiek nyankeuh peunyaket nyang musabab le patogen, lage virus, kumeun, kulat atawa glang.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Peunyaket nyang jiek nyankeuh peunyaket nyang mudah jiek deungoen na teuh toe ngoen ureueng nyang teungoeh saket.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Dum pomeurentah geuyue tamoeng ureueng jak tamasya, jeuet keu ureueng teumpat tinggai, nanggroe awak nyan jivaksin meubagoe peunyaket.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Peusyaratan nyoe mungken meunurot pue nyang kayem jisaweu atawa le ureueng jak tamasya.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Salah saboh hai nyang teuleubéh di Charlotte, Carolina Utara, nyankeuh jai teumpat got nyang jeut tapileh keu keuluarga.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Ureueng bak wilayah laén kayem geukheun piasan meusyédara jeut keu sabab phôn taminah keunan, ‘oh lheueh nyan jamèe kayeum geurasa kuta nyan mangat keu meu’en ngön aneuk miet.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Lam 20 thôn nyang ka leupah, dum teumpat nyang aneuk miet galak bak kuta Charlotte ka meutamah bagah lagoina.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Taksi hana kayeum geuék lé ureueng di Charlotte, adakpi meunan na cit geuék lam meujan watèe.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Na ongkoh tamah meunyoe leubéh dari 2 droe peunumpang, nyoe keuh nyang peugot yum taksi leubéh meuh’ai nibak nyang jipeureulèe.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antartika nakeuh teumpat teuleupie di Bumoe, ngon meukeulileng Kutop Seulatan.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Keumunjong turis meuhai, geutuntot beusehat badan, hanya jeut watee musem seuuem Nov-Feb, ngon seubagian rayek hanya jeuet di Semenanjung, Kepulauan, ngon Laot Ross.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Napadum ribee staf tinggai di sinoe di musem seuuem di seukitar peuet lusen teumpat piyoh nyang biasajih le di daerah nyan; seujumlah ubit laen tinggai seulama musem leupie.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Antartika Peudalaman nakeuh dataran lambong terpencil nyang ditop le 2-3 km eh.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Tur spesialis udara sigo-go jak keu pedalaman, keu meuek gunong atawa keu capoe Kutub nyang na uram rayek.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: South Pole Traverse (atawa Jalan Raya) panyangjih 1600 km dari Stasion McMurdo di ateuh Laôt Ross u Kutob.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Jalan raya nyan nakeuh salju nyang dipeupadat ngön jeureulong yang dipasoe salju, ‘aleuh nyan disinan diboh bandira keu tanda. Jalan nyan cuma jeut dijak lé moto meu’ue khusus, moto angkot geuritan salju deungön minyeuk bensen ngön dabeuh.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Moto angkotan nyan hana that bagah, nyan keuh payah jak dikilek liwat Gunong Transantartika mangat trok u tanoh nyang manyang.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Sabab nyang paléng kayem jeut keu ceulaka bak musem salju nyankeuh licen jalan, jalan geunireng (bineh jalan keu ureueng jak ngön tapak) ngön nyang paléng peunteng nyankeuh langkah gaki.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Paléng kureung, gata peureulèe sipatu nyang pah deungön tapak gaki. Sipatu musem seuuem biasajih licen that bak eh ngön salju, ladom sipatu musem leupie pih kureueng got.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Bungong tapak sipatu jih beusep lhok, 5 mm (1/5 inch) atawa leubéh, ngön bahan nyang beusep lembut lam cuwaca leupie.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Ladom sipatu na pancang ngön na dipeuduek alat tamah bah bèk meusireuk, pah keu dum seulop ngön sipatu, keu geunue atawa tumet ngön tapak gaki.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Tumet beumiyup ngön luwah. Anoe, aneuk batèe atawa sira (kalsium klorida) kayem ditabu bak jalan atawa rot bah mangat watèe geujak.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Salju luroh kon saboh hai nyang hana normal; bineh gle nyang lhok cuma jeut jitheun meulek bacut, ngön teuleubéh geuhon asoe nyan jeut keuh keu rheut salju.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Masalahjih nyankeuh salju nyan leukiet, peureulèe na nyang peuphôn bah ditren, ngön ladom salju pih ditren jeut keu nyang peuphôn musibah nyan selanjutjih.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Meujan-jan nyang peuphôn musibah nyan nyankeuh mata uroe nyang peuseuuem salju nyan, meujan-jan seubap salju nyang ditren leubéh le, meujan-jan seubap alam, nyang kayem nyankeuh seubap ureung.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Tornado nakeuh saboh tameh meupuseng asoejih udara teukanan rendah, nyang hu’ep angén bak seulingkajih u dalam ngön u ateuh.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Tornado nyan peujeut angén teuga (kayem 100-200 mil/jeum) ngön jeut dibet dabeueh nyang geuhon u ateuh langet, dimè dabeuh-dabeuh nyan mandum watèe tornado meugrak.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Tornado meupunca sebagoe corong itroen dari awan badé, ngön jeut keu "tornado" watèe trok u tanoh.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Penyedia VPN pribadi (virtual private network) nakeuh cara leubéh get geuhindar mandua sensor politek ngön geusareng IP komersial.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Awak nyan leubéh maju keu proxy web sebab padum boh alasan: Awak nyan geu-set mandum lalu lintas internet, kon http sagai.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Awak nyan biasajih peutaba bandwidth leubéh manyang ngön kualitah peulayanan leubéh get. Awak nyan dienkripsi makajih leubéh payah diseulidek.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Kanto berita sabèe sulet bah meukusud nyoe, dipeugah nyan keuh keu "meunceugah peumbajakan".
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Faktajih, kode wilayah hana meupeungaroh keu Salinan illegal; bacut-bacut jisalen dari disk nyang jineuk puta deungön get bak peurangkat dumpat na aslijih diputa.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Meukusud seubeutoijih nakeuh di jok keu kanto-kanto keundali leubéh rayek keu peukan awak nyan; nyan mandum teuntang puta peng.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Sebab di hoi rute rot Internet, gata hana peurlèe ngui saboh kanto télépon teumpat dipat gata tinggai atawa dipat tajak.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Pih hana syarat keu gata meurumpok numboi lokal dari teumpat gata tinggai; gata jeut meurumpok sinambong internet sateulit bak manok kleut, Alaska ngön pileh numboi nyang pat jeut gata na i matauroe tarek Arizona.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Gata suah tabloe numboi global meupisah nyang télépon PSTN jeut tahubông keu gata. Dipat asai numboi nyan nakeuh saboh peurbedaan keu ureung nyang hubông gata.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Aplikasi peuneurjeumah kata watèe nyoe – aplikasi nyang jeut otomatis meuboh makna mandum segmen kata dari saboh basa keu basa laén.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Padum aplikasi lam keunira nyoe jeut meuboh makna kata lam basa aséng atawa padum boh objek lam dônya nyata watèe soe nyang paké geupeuarah télépon carong keu arah objek.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Mesen peuneurjemah ka jiék deungön dramatis, ngön jino kayem dijok leubéh kureung teurjemahan beutoi (ngön leubéh jareung haba soeh), tapi peurhatian peurlèe, sabab mesin-mesin nyan mungkén manteng salah.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Salah saboh aplikasi paléng deuh dalam keunira nyoe nakeuh Google Translate, nyang mungkén peuneurjemahan online leuh unduh data basa nyang peurlèe.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Paké aplikasi petunyok arah GPS bak telpon carong gata jeut keu mudah ngön cara paléng nyaman keu peutunyok arah watèe gata di luwa nanggroe.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Nyoe jeut keubah peng dari bloe peuta barô keu saboh GPS, atawa peurangkat GPS ata droe atawa siwa saboh dari salah saboh kanto rental moto.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Miseu gata hana meurumpok koneksi keu télépon gata, atawa watèe diluwa jangkauan, keurija jih jeut teurbatas atawa hana teusedia.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Tiep sagoe keude meupasoe deungön meubareh-bareh kartu télépon sigohlom-bayeue nyang jeut dipaké dari télépon umum atawa pih télépon biasa.
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Seumeuntara seubagoe lë kartu get keu télépon dumho, padum boh spesialis dalam dijok yum panggelan keu keulompok nanggroe meuteuntèe.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Akses keu layanan nyoe kayem dijok rot numboi télépon bebah pulsa nyan jeut jihubông dari télépon hana bayeue.
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Atoran bhah fotografi biasa pih jeut keu reukam video, mungkén jeut leubéh.
eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Miseu cok saboh poto hana dibie idin, makajih hana suah tapiké reukam video nyan.
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Miseu neupaké drone, neupareksa dilèe peu nyang jeut tarekam atawa idin tatamah nyang dipeurlèe.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Dipo saboh drone toe bandara atawa diateuh ureueng ramé nakeuh saboh ide hana get, bahkan miseu nyan hana illegal lam dairah gata.
eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Saat nyoe tiket peurjalanan udara jareung dipeusan langsong rot maskapai kon phôn geuseutot ngön geubandengkan yum.
eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Kadang peuneurbangan nyang sama geujok yum meubeda nibak mandum agregator ngön nyan dibayeue keu mita peurbandéngan ngön geukalon bak website peuneurbangan nyan sigohlom dipeusan.
eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Adak pih gata hana peurlèe saboh visa keu saweu siat keu nanggroe meuteute sebagoe turis atawa bisnis, jak keudeh sebagoe peulajar internasional umumjih peurlèe watèe tinggai leubéh trep daripada jak keudeh sebagoe turis sagai.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Umumjih, tinggai i nanggroe laén lam watèe nyang trep suah tameurumpok visa phôn-phôn that.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Visa peulajar umumjih dijok syarat meubeda ngön prosedur aplikasi dari visa ureung aséng normal atawa visa ureung keureuja.
eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Keu sibahgian lë nanggroe, gata tapeurlèe surat dari institusi teumpat gata meurunoe, ngön bukti peng keu dukôngan droe teuh sekureueng-kureuengjih sithôn gata meurunoe.
eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Tateumanyong bak institusi, seureuta departemen imigrasi keu nanggroe teumpat gata keuneuk meurunoe keu syarat leungkap.
eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Keucuali gata sidroe diplomat, keuruja di luwa nanggroe pada umumjih meumakna gata suah bayeue pajak wasé di nanggroe teumpat gata tinggai.
eng_text: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Pajak wasé di suson meubeda tiep tiep nanggroe, ngön hareuga pajak seureuta tanda kureung meumacam bagoe dari saboh nanggroe keu nyang laén.
eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Di padum boh nanggroe federal, lage Amèrika Serikat ngön Kanada, pajak wasé dilakèe mandua bak level federal ngön level lokal, sampoe hareuga ngön tanda kureung jeut meumacam bagoe dari saboh wilayah keu wilayah laén.
eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Seumentara peumareksaan imigrasi biasajih hana atawa keu syarat watèe gata troh u tanoh-ie gata, kontrol bea cukai jeut keu karu.
eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Tapeuteuntèe lé droeteuh puetra nyang jeuet ngön nyang hanjeuet taba ngön pu nyang ta peunyata diluwa batah nyang jeuet.
eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Cara nyang paléng mudah untuk ta mulai usaha bak bidang teumuleh tentang travel nakeuh deungön neu peumah‘e droeneuh bak bidang teumuleh di website blog travel.
eng_text: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Alheueh droeneuh mah‘e cara neuatô ngön neu-edit bak web, alheueh nyan, mungkén droeneuh jeut neumulai peuget website droe.
eng_text: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Peutaba droe watèe tajak lam traveling nakeuh saboh cara nyang get untuk tapeugot saboh hai nyang meubeda tapi nyan keun cuma tentang buet jok.
eng_text: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Meu udép ngön peutaba droe untuk udép di lua nanggroe nakeuh saboh cara nyang get untuk ta meureuno tentang budaya nyang meubeda, meuturi deungön urueng barô, meuruno hai tentang droe teuh, ta teumèe saboh pandangan barô akan hai ngön bahkan jeut ta teumèe saboh skill nyang barô.
eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Nyoe pih jeuet keu saboh cara nyang get untuk ta peurayek asoe dompet untuk jeuet ta tinggai leubéh trep bak saboh tempat karna lë buet-buet nyang dipeutaba nyang jeut di bri teumpat untuk ta duek ngön ladom na nyang di bri bacut keu gaji.
eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Ureueng Viking dipaké jalan ie ureueng Russia untuk jak u Laôt Black ngön Laôt Caspian. Bagian-bagian dari jalan nyoe manteng jeuet ta paké jino. Neu cek hai nyang peureulèe untuk izin-izin nyang khusus, nyang mungkén payah bak neu teumèe.
eng_text: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: White Sea-Baltic Canal peusambông laôt Artik deungön laôt Baltic, dari danau Onega, danau Ladoga ngön Saint Petersburg, leubéh lë dari krueng-krueng ngön danau-danau.
eng_text: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Danau Onega pih meusambông deungön Volga, jadi tajak dari laôt Caspian rhet Russia manteng mungkén.
eng_text: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Beu neupeuyakin droeneuh bahwa sigoe droeneuh teuka u tempat meulaboh kapai mandum hai ka deuh trang. Droeneuh akan neu mereumpok penumpang-penumpang kapai nyang laén ngön ureueng-ureueng nyan akan geu bri informasi keu droeneuh.
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Pada dasarjih droeneuh akan diumumkan tanda keu bantuan droeneuh, neuputa-puta dermaga, neupeutoe ureueng nyang teungoh geurah kapai, neuusaha untuk neupeugah haba dengan awak kapai dalam bar, ngön laén-laén.
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Neuusaha untuk neupeugah haba deungön ureueng beu le. Alheueh nyan mandum ureueng akan geuturi droeneuh ngön akan geujok peutunyok keu droneuh nyang töh kapai nyang peureulèe ureueng.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Droeneuh wajeb neu pileh maskapai penerbangan lam saboh syarikat deungön beuleuheun.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Adak pih mungkén droeneuh neu piké bahwa nyoe hai nyang wajar untuk ta pileh masakapai penerbangan nyang kayem neu jak ék, droeneuh wajeb neu teupu bahwa na keuleubéhan-keuleubéhan nyang di peutaba meubeda ngön kayeum poin peulanggan maskapai nyang di peutaba leubéh got nibak saboh maskapai lam saboh syarikat.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Maskapai-maskapai lagèe Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines ka di peuluwah wilayah phe kapai troh u Afrika, ngön di peutaba tujuan u kuta-kuta nyang na di Afrika deungön yum nyang leubéh murah dari Maskapai-maskapai Eropa.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Maskapai Turki di phe u 39 boh wilayah tujuan di 30 boh nanggroe nyang na di Afrika watèe thôn 2014.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Meunyoe droeneuh na leubéh watèe pre, jeut neu-eu jumlah mandum dari yum u Afrika di bandeng deungön biaya jak keulileng dônya.
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Bèk tuwo neu tamah biaya keu tambahan visa, pajak watèe ta phe, biaya jak di darat, ngön sabagoejih keu mandum teumpat-teumpat nyan nyang diluwa Africa.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Meunyoe droeneuh na hawa neu phe u keulileng dônya ban mandum bak wilayah tunong bumoe, pilihan untuk jak rhet nan ngön untuk tujuan keunan nyan sangat terbatah kareuna dit that kapai phe ateuh laôt arah wilayah keunan.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Hana meusaboh pih syarikat maskapai nyang meucakop ban lhèe boh laôt raya nyang na di wilayah tunong bumoe (SkyTeam hana di cakop ban saboh pih wilayah nyan).
eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Tapi, Star Alliance mencakop mandum wilayah kecuali wilayah timu South Pacific dari Santiago de Chile u Tahiti, nyan keuh nyan penerbangan LATAM Oneworld.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Penerbangan nyoe kon saboh-saboh jih cara meunyo droeneuh meuheut neupeuliwat arah phe South Pacific ngön wilyah panté barat dari Amèrika Selatan. (neu kalen di yup)
eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Nibak thôn 1994, wilayah etnis Armenia Nagorno-Karabakh i Azerbaijan geupeubeureutoh prang geulawan Azeri.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Deungön dukôngan Armenia, peumeurintahan barô ka jipeugot. Tapi, hana nanggroe - bahkan meu ureueng Armenia - geuakui seucara reusmi.
eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Argumen diplomatik bak wilayah nyan sabèe jipeubroek hubungan antara Armenia ngön Azerbaijan.
eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Saluran Wilayah Kanal (Beulanda: Grachtengordel) nyan keuh wilayah bak abad keu-17 nyang meusyeuhu seulingka Binnenstad Amsterdam.
eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Ban mandum wilayah jiteutapkan seubagoe saboh situs Peuwareh Dônya UNESCO sabab nilai budaya ngön seujarah nyang unik.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, nyang meumakna limoeng boh nanggroe, na limoeng boh gampong bineh pasi ubeut Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza ngön Monterosso nyang na di wilayah Italia Liguria.
eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Wilayah nyan ka teudaftar bak dafta peuwareh dônya UNESCO.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Sampoe meu abad-abad, ureueng sep brat leuheun geu peugot trah bak teumpat nyang gasa, peumandangan nyang lhok sampoe u bineh nyang meuhadap keu u laôt.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Saboh bahgi nyang meunawan hate nyan keuh peungeumbangan peurusahaan nyang deuh ta kalon. Jalan sitapak gaki, geureutan apui, ngön jaloe peu sinambong gampong gampong, ngön moto nyang hana ék ta jangkau awak nyang dari luwa.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Jeuneh basa Prancis nyang jipaké di Belgia ngön Swiss meubeda bacut deungön basa Prancis nyang na di Prancis, bahpih banduajih karab sama bak dipeuphom.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Leubéh khususjih, nibak cara peulimboi basa Prancis nyang jipeugah di Belgia ngön Swiss na bacut khas meubeda deungön basa Prancis nyang jipaké di Prancis, ngön cara peulafai na padum boh kata bacut meubeda.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Bahpih meunan, mandum ureueng Belgia ngön ureung Swiss nyang meubasa Prancis ka jimeurunoe basa Prancis nyang ka teutap bak Sikula, sampoe awak nyan meuphom bahpih droe neuh neupaké cara peulimboi lage sistem Prancis.
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Rab mandum bahgian dônya, geu beuot jaroe nyan sipheut rumeh, nyan isyarat "halo."
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Adak pih, di Malaysia, na padum droe ureung Meulayu gampong, nyan meumakna "jak keunoe" lage jaroe punyok tunyok u tuboh, grak nyan jipaké lé padum-padum teumpat di nanggroe Barat, ngön wajeb jipaké keu nyan sagai.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Meunan sit, Sidroe-droe jamèe inggreh mungkén na salah meunyoe jikhen seulamat tinggai deungön cara beuot jaroe meuhadap keu ureueng nyan meumakna sebagoe grak neuk wo.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Basa Auxiliary nyan keuh basa-basa jipeugot atawa jipeujeut deungön meukusud keu peuhubông tameututoe deungön ureueng-ureueng nyang pueh meututoe.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Mandum nyan muepisah nibak lingua franca, nyan keuh basa alami atawa aseulie nyang jai dipaké sabab na saboh atawa laén hai sebagoe teumpat meututoe deungön awak laén.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Bak cot uroe nyang suum, peujeulajah meutume rasa fatamorgana nyang ibi bayangan ie (atawa hai nyang laén).
eng_text: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Nyoe jeut keu saboh bahaya meunyoe awak penjeulajah yak seutot fatamorgana, abeh watèe, abeh teunaga ngön ie jep nyang teusisa.
eng_text: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Bah guron nyang sep suum pih jeut sep that lupie oh watèe malam uroe. Hipotermia nyan peunyaket nyata meuseu hana baje tubai.
eng_text: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Bak musem suum, khususjih, droe neuh wajeb beu leuheun-leuheun keu nyamok meuseu neuk ék gunong rhot uteun.
eng_text: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Bahpih meunyoe droeneuh neumè moto rhot uteun ujeuen subtropis, padum at manteng pintoe teuhah watèe neuk tamong lam moto nyan watèe nyang sep keu nyamok itamong lam moto droeneuh.
eng_text: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Flu Burung, atawa jikheun leubéh reusmi avian influenza, nyang jeut keunong cicem atawa mamalia.
eng_text: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Kureung nibak siribe kasus na diadue nyang keunong manusiya, tapi padum-padum droe nibak awak nyan na nyang meuninggai.
eng_text: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Jai nibak awak nyan urueung nyang peulhara bak bangsa manok, na sit nibak awak nyan galak kalon cicem.
eng_text: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Khususjih keu norwegia nyan keuh fjord ngön leumbah nyang lhok lam sigra meuubah jeut keu buket manyang nyang leubéh kureung santeut.
eng_text: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Miyup-miyup manyang nyoe kayem geupeugah "vidde" nyang meumakna kama, tehah luah hana bak kayèe, teu leung hana ceu.
eng_text: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Di Rogaland ngön Agder awak nyan kayem geupeugah "hei" nyang meumakna lampoh hana bak kayèe kayem meutop.
eng_text: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Gletser hana stabil, tapi dile tron dari gunong. Nyoe keuh sababjih crah, ceulah, nyang mungkén meutop ngön tutue salju.
eng_text: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Binteh ngön bubong guha eh jeut runtoh ngön crah jeut meutop.
eng_text: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Di bineh gletser, balok-balok rayek tepeleuh, rhot ngön mungkén jigrop atawa meugule leubéh jioh u bineh.
